kpar_pattern.definition: A shape that several facts share, which is easier to see than the facts themselves.
kpar_pattern.example: The same pattern is in all three faults: the seal starts to leak before the part fails.

lunch_box.definition: A box that carries the food you eat at the school break.
lunch_box.example: My lunch box has rice and chicken in it.

offsiting.definition: Working from a shared space other than your own home, which many employers offer or pay for.
offsiting.example: My company gave me an offsiting budget of two hundred dollars a month.

wait.definition: To stay calm and do something else until your turn comes.
wait.example: I wait until my friend finishes the puzzle.
